items.title: Define the parameterized injection contract
items.context: Map the existing fixed recovery-runner scenario model to a conservative parameter schema for probability, distribution seed, and composition without changing the existing frozen B1-B15 protocol.
items.userSees: Terminal includes "profile default: scenarios=null,B1..B15" and "profile weighted: scenarios=B1,B1,B2" in the selfcheck output.

happy.desc: default fixed protocol still expands to null+B1-B15 with existing counts when no profile flag is supplied
a weighted profile such as B1:2,B2:1 expands deterministically to the expected scenario list for a fixed seed

edge.desc: subset/list profile can select a valid explicit scenario subset without touching the canonical default constants

adversarial.desc: unknown scenario ids, duplicate malformed weights, and zero or negative weights fail closed with clear validation errors

verificationEvidence.note: Selfcheck proves no-profile parseScenarioProfile returns fixed/default selection and existing fixed enumeration counts remain unchanged; output ended with 157 assertions passed.
Weighted B1:2,B2:1 expands as B1,B1,B2 while generated canonical runIds are unique: 15 cells and 15 unique runIds.
Selfcheck covers list profile B1,B2,B3 preserving explicit order and validating against RECOVERY_SCENARIOS without changing fixed defaults.

verificationEvidence.command: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --scenarioProfile weighted --scenarioParams B1:0 --tasks foo --seed fixed --k 1; test $? -eq 2
verificationEvidence.note: Invalid zero weight fails closed with exit 2 and clear invalid scenario profile diagnostic before writing sidecars.

items.title: Implement recovery-runner parameter parsing behind an explicit mode
items.context: Add the smallest code path needed for exploratory parameterized runs, keeping default behavior identical and avoiding changes to lifecycle gate semantics.
items.userSees: Terminal includes "[run-driver] scenario profile weighted: B1,B1,B2" and then "no --engine provided: refusing to run a live campaign".

happy.desc: run-driver CLI accepts an explicit exploratory weighted profile and enumerates the profile-derived cells without requiring a live engine

edge.desc: without profile flags, existing --tasks/--k/--seed behavior remains byte-compatible for applicable and N/A counts

adversarial.desc: profile flags cannot override record assembly, denominator computation, adjudication, or live-engine refusal behavior

verificationEvidence.note: Focused CLI run printed [run-driver] scenario profile weighted: B1,B1,B2, enumerated 15 applicable cells, and preserved the no-engine live campaign refusal.
Selfcheck retained default fixed protocol enumeration assertions including 77 cells for one task at k=1 and 231 cells for three tasks at k=1.

verificationEvidence.command: main-agent source/diff review plus weighted unique-runId probe
verificationEvidence.note: Profile parsing only changes the explicit scenarios list passed to enumerateCells; record assembly, adjudication, denominator logic, and no-engine refusal remain on existing paths, and duplicate weighted slots no longer duplicate canonical runIds.

items.title: Add regression coverage for fixed and parameterized runs
items.context: Prove default fixed scenarios remain unchanged, seeded parameterized runs are deterministic, and invalid parameter combinations fail closed with clear diagnostics.
items.userSees: Terminal ends with "run-driver-selfcheck: <N> assertions passed, 0 failed (no live LLM)".

happy.desc: run-driver-selfcheck covers default fixed B1-B15 counts and the new profile expansion path in the same offline command

edge.desc: same seed and same profile produce byte-identical scenario expansion and JSONL enumeration metadata

adversarial.desc: malformed profile CLI inputs exit non-zero before writing misleading records or sidecar logs

verificationEvidence.note: Selfcheck covers fixed B1-B15 defaults, list/weighted profile parsing, CLI integration, invalid profile rejection, and ended with 157 assertions passed, 0 failed.
Same weighted profile and seed produce deterministic cells with no duplicate canonical runIds; B1 duplicate slots are represented by offset repeat values rather than duplicate identities.

verificationEvidence.command: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --scenarioProfile weighted --scenarioParams B1:0 --tasks foo --seed fixed --k 1; test $? -eq 2
verificationEvidence.note: Malformed invalid weight exits 2 before sidecar writes; selfcheck also asserts invalid profile creates no exclusions or voids sidecars.

items.title: Document non-goals and safe usage boundary
items.context: Document that this is an offline robustness harness for exploratory red-team studies, not lossy evidence recovery, not a gate shortcut, and not a claim of unattended production readiness.
items.userSees: Docs contain the exact phrases "exploratory offline profile", "fixed B1-B15 remains the default", and "not lifecycle gate evidence".

happy.desc: README and decision docs describe the explicit profile flags and safe offline use

edge.desc: docs say fixed B1-B15 remains the default/pre-registered protocol and profile runs are exploratory

adversarial.desc: docs explicitly reject fountain/erasure recovery, lifecycle gate shortcuts, and production-readiness claims for this feature
